translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: E ndalono wendni nower e piny Juda ni:

content.text: Wan gi dala maduongʼ man-gi teko;
Nyasaye kelo resruok e ohingane gi kuonde molwore.
Yaw dhorangeye
mondo oganda makare odonji,
oganda morito yie.
Inirit gi kwe ngʼatno ma parone oriere tir,
nikech ogeno kuomi.
Gen kuom Jehova Nyasaye nyaka chiengʼ,
nimar Jehova Nyasaye en Jehova Nyasaye ma Lwanda nyaka chiengʼ.
Odwoko piny joma otingʼore malo,
odwoko dala maduongʼ mar ngʼayi piny,
mi otoye matindo tindo ma olokre buru.
Tiende joma ithiro
kod mag joma odhier nyone piny.
Yor joma kare opie,
yaye in Jal makare, iloso yor joma kare bedo maber.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wuotho e yore mag chikeni ema warito,
nyingi kod duongʼ mari ema chunywa dwaro.
Chunya gombi gotieno
kendo chunya dwari gokinyi.
Ka buchi makare biro e piny,
ogendini mag piny puonjore yo makare.
Kata obedo ni ngʼwono itimone joricho,
to ok gipuonjore tim makare;
kata mana e piny joma kare gidhi nyime mana ka gitimo richo,
ka ok gichiwo luor ne duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isetingʼo badi malo,
to ok gine.
We mondo gine geno ma in-go,
kuom jogi mi giyud wichkuot,
kendo mad mach mokan ne wasiki wangʼ-gi duto.
Jehova Nyasaye, isemiyowa kwe;
kendo gik moko duto ma wasetimo in ema isetimonwa.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa,
ruodhi mamoko ma ok in osetiyowa,
makmana nyingi kende ema wamiyo luor.
To koro jogo osetho kendo koro gionge;
chunje moseago ok nochier.
Ne ikumogi mi itiekogi maonge ngʼama parogi.
Isemedo ogandawa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
isemedo ogandawa.
Iseyudo duongʼ mana ne in iwuon;
kendo isemedo tongʼ duto mar pinywa.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
negimanyi e kinde mane ginie chandruok;
kendo kane ikumogi ne gionge gi teko mar lemo.
Mana kaka dhako man-gi ich machiegni nywol
muoch kayo kendo ywak kawinjo rem mano,
bende e kaka wanie nyimi yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
Wasebedo gi ich,
muoch osekayowa malit to ne wanywolo mana yamo.
Ok wasekelo warruok e piny,
bende pod ok wanywolo ji e piny.
To jogi mosenindo kuom Jehova Nyasaye,
nobed mangima,
kendo ringregi nochier.
In misiko e buru,
chiew kendo igo koko gi mor.
Thoo ma in-go chalo thoo mar okinyi,
piny biro golo joma otho oko.
Dhiuru, un joga, donjuru e uteu
kendo loruru dhoutu,
ponduru kuom ndalo matin
nyaka ndalo mar mirimbe kal.
To ne, Jehova Nyasaye biro kawuok kare mar dak
mondo okum joma odak e piny kuom richogi.
Piny noket ayanga remo mosechwer kuome,
mi ok noum joge mosenegi.
